svg.aria-label: Not converted to SVG. The gold type and the gold Deco ornament are the same colour and much the same scale, so nothing measurable separates them. On a pure black ground the neutral masks are empty and everything lands in one colour mask of 400,000 pixels: rays, borders and lettering alike. That yields 19 candidate lines of which only about 8 are text, and the aligner puts the headline on a 21-pixel band. The type is font-like and the ground is flat, so this is a limit of telling ornament from lettering, not of the poster.
svg.title: Not converted to SVG — Art Deco — gig poster
